description.en:
Municipality borders, attribute data includes the number and the name of the municipality in Finnish and Swedish. Additionally the dataset includes separate Shape-files about counties and Regional State Administrative Agency borders. 

Coordinate Reference System: ETRS89 / ETRS-TM35FIN (EPSG:3067)

creator: National Land Survey of Finland
keyword: centres for economic development, transport and the environment
